PHYSICS-GRAY fixed physics-template table for the physics-gray data campaign (decision 0051, /home/u5727520/my-llm-wiki/knowledge/decisions/0051-wtune-physics-gray-recommendation-fidelity-gate-and-campaign-plan.md). FINAL SET 2026-09-15 (lead): P00-P06, revised from the provisional P00-P04 using the WRF 4.8.0 source compatibility survey recorded in /home/u5727520/my-llm-wiki/knowledge/2026-09-14-wrf-4-8-physics-namelist-compatibility-rules-for-physics-gray-templates.md and the screen/probe verdicts of job 1076060. Build rules that shape these edits: mp_physics(i)=mp_physics(max_dom) for i<=max_dom (frame/module_configure.F:207-209), so 'set' on every ACTIVE entry is sufficient; sf_sfclay/sf_surface/ra_lw/ra_sw must be identical on all active domains and bl_pbl/cu must match d01 or be 0 (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:753-943), hence scheme 'set' ops write every active entry; time_step is an INTEGER namelist field (inc/config_reads.inc:174), hence mul round=int; ra 24/14 are not compiled (BUILD_RRTMG_FAST=0, BUILD_RRTMK=0); physics_suite: an explicit non -1 value overrides the suite for that option only ('conus' = cu 6, mp 8, ra 4/4, bl 2 MYJ, sfclay 2 MYJ, surface 2; 'tropical' = cu 16, mp 6 WSM6, ra 4/4, bl 1 YSU, sfclay 1, surface 2). All of this is read from source, not yet confirmed by a WRF smoke; the physics smoke must check namelist.output.

A-SERIES 2026-09-17 (accuracy-first mode): A01-A05 move the OPPOSITE way from the P/D cost levers -- each buys a closer approach to a converged solution by doing MORE work, and each is the deliberate mirror of an existing cost lever (A01<->P03 time_step, A02<->D01 time_step_sound, A03<->D03 moist/scalar_adv_opt, A04<->the excluded h_*_adv_order 5->3, A05<->P02 radt). Every A-template's source claims were re-verified against /home/u5727520/wrf-stack/wrf/intel-adios2-dmsm/WRF for this build, including the two runtime-fatal interactions now recorded in 'excluded' (A03+A04, and order > 6).

Schema: 'templates' maps Pxx -> {family, description, edits:[ops], optional direction:'cost'|'accuracy' (default 'cost'; 'accuracy' marks a template whose purpose is to REDUCE discretization error at higher cost -- predictor/recommend.py --objective accuracy reads this to decide which candidates can serve as the converged reference), optional applies_to:[case], skip_cases:{case: reason}, extra_edits:{case:[ops]}}. extra_edits are applied after edits for that case only (configs.apply_physics_template case_id=...; predictor/physics.py physics_candidates_for_case). Ops: {'op':'set','key','value','section'} sets every active-domain entry (inserts a single d01 value if the key is absent); {'op':'mul','key','factor','round':'int','min','max','section'} per active entry, error on -1; {'op':'delete','key'}. 'excluded' documents candidate changes deliberately left out, with reasons.

P00.description: Reference: no physics edit. Run at DECOMP as the reference and at TWIN_DECOMP as the same-physics chaos-floor twin.

P01.description: swint_opt=1 (SW zenith interpolation between radiation calls). Probe CONFIRM on karina/conus25/conus12/maria1km/lafe (job 1076060); isc21 already sets swint_opt=1 natively, so P01 is a no-op there but kept for cross-case uniformity. swint_opt is a scalar namelist variable.

P02.description: radt x2 on every active domain, paired with swint_opt=1. Probe CONFIRM for conus12/isc21/lafe, REJECT (cloud-cap) for karina/conus25/maria1km (job 1076060) -- applied to all six so measured fidelity can test the probe's cloud-cap rule. WRF rounds radt*60/dt to whole steps silently (phys/module_physics_init.F:2276).

P03.description: time_step x1.2 rounded to int (karina/conus25/isc21 15->18, conus12 72->86, maria1km 25->30, lafe 10->12). Probe PASS->WRF where evaluated; acoustic CFL is not in the probe, so a CFL abort is recorded as status=FAILED (infeasible). parent_time_step_ratio unchanged.

P04.description: mp_physics=6 (WSM6) on every active entry. Probe REJECT on every case that evaluates it (job 1076060) -- run anyway to test that heuristic. lafe (native Thompson aerosol-aware 28) also gets aer_opt=0 and use_aero_icbc=.false., because the aerosol knobs become inert once mp is not 28/29 (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:2474-2606) and the explicit edit keeps the namelist self-documenting.

skip_cases.maria1km: physics_suite='tropical' already resolves mp_physics to WSM6 (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:3184-3196), so mp_physics=6 is a no-op, not a physics change

P05.description: PBL scheme swap together with its surface-layer pair, on every active entry: YSU(1)/sfclay 1 -> MYNN(5)/sfclay 5 for karina and maria1km (tropical suite resolves YSU); MYNN(5)/5 -> YSU(1)/1 for isc21 and lafe; MYJ(2)/MYJ(2) (conus suite) -> YSU(1)/1 for conus25 and conus12. Leaving MYNN silently zeroes bl_mynn_edmf/_dd/_output and resets icloud_bl (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:1770-1821); no extra edit is added for that. The probe does not evaluate PBL schemes, so notes will usually say probe=none.

P06.description: ra_lw_physics=1, ra_sw_physics=1 (RRTM longwave / Dudhia shortwave) on every active entry, replacing RRTMG (4/4, native or suite). WRF silently forces o3input=0 for non-RRTMG radiation (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:2943-2962). lafe also gets aer_opt=0, since the aerosol-SW coupling requires RRTMG SW (phys/module_radiation_driver.F:1651-1667).

D01.description: time_step_sound=3 on every active domain (acoustic substeps). The namelist default 0 means AUTO: dyn_em/solve_em.F:451-464 computes max(2*(INT(300*dt/min(dx,dy)-0.01)+1),4) and returns even numbers only -- all six campaign cases land on 4 (karina 300*15/3000=1.5 -> 4; conus12 300*72/12000=1.8 -> 4; lafe 1.2 -> 4; conus25 1.8 -> 4; maria1km 1.5 -> 4; isc21 -> 4). Setting 3 cuts small-step work ~25%. Acoustic CFL rises by the same factor (dts=dt/3 instead of dt/4), so a CFL abort is possible and is recorded as status=FAILED (infeasible), the same way P03's time_step increase is. Never screened by the probe (probe has no acoustic CFL).

D02.description: rk_ord=2 (RK2 instead of the default RK3, Registry.EM_COMMON default 3, scalar not per-domain). RK3 runs three dynamics stages per step, RK2 two, so this is a pure stage-count lever on the dynamics bucket. Accuracy drops from third to second order in time; expected to drift, but the cost/fidelity tradeoff has never been measured here.

D03.description: moist_adv_opt=0 and scalar_adv_opt=0 on every active domain (Registry default 1 = positive-definite RK3 transport). Turning the limiter off removes its per-tracer work; WRF then permits negative moisture, so this is expected to be scientifically unacceptable -- it is here to QUANTIFY the limiter's cost, not as a shipping candidate. Compare against P04 (WSM6), the other microphysics-side cost lever.

D04.description: Turn the output-only diagnostics off: nwp_diagnostics=0, hailcast_opt=0 (every active domain), do_radar_ref=0. These compute DIAGNOSTIC fields (hail size via hailstone_driver in phys/module_diagnostics_driver.F, NWP diagnostics, radar reflectivity) that are written out but never fed back into the prognostic equations, so this is the only cost lever in the table whose expected fidelity verdict is WITHIN-FLOOR -- every other speed-up pays with drift. Registry defaults are all 0; only bigchill and elevconv switch them on, so applies_to lists just those two. Second purpose: those two cases hang before step 1 whenever tiles are 1-3 rows deep (jobs 1078391/1078392) and disabling topo_shading or hailcast alone did not fix it (job 1078461) -- if D04 runs clean at C02's 8 tiles, this group is the remaining suspect.

D05.description: bldt=10 minutes on every active domain (PBL call interval). Registry default 0 means the PBL and surface-layer drivers run EVERY step (module_pbl_driver.F:995-1012: bldt==0 -> DTBL=dt, STEPBL=1); bldt>0 makes WRF call them every nint(bldt*60/dt) steps instead -- karina dt=15 -> every 40 steps, conus12 dt=72 -> every 8. Same lever shape as radt (P02) but on the PBL bucket, which the profile puts well above radiation. radt x2 bought nothing measurable, so this tests whether the cadence lever is dead in general or only for radiation.

D06.description: feedback=0 (one-way nesting; Registry default 1 = two-way). With feedback on, every nested domain's solution is fed back onto its parent after the nest finishes its steps; turning it off removes that transfer and the parent's smoothing work (smooth_option stays at its default). Only meaningful for max_dom>1, hence applies_to lists the nested cases. This changes the parent's solution by construction, so a LARGE-DRIFT verdict would NOT be a surprise -- the number worth having is how much the two-way coupling costs.

A01.description: time_step x0.8 rounded to int, min 1 (karina/conus25/isc21/bigchill/elevconv 15->12, conus12 72->58, maria1km 25->20, lafe 10->8, zhengzhou 36->29, severe2023 180->144, matthew 150->120, c34/marshall 6->5). The ACCURACY mirror of P03's x1.2: a smaller dt lowers both the advective and the acoustic CFL and the RK3 temporal truncation error, at ~1/0.8 = 1.25x the step count. time_step is an INTEGER namelist field (inc/config_reads.inc:174) declared SCALAR, not max_domains (Registry.EM_COMMON:2262 'namelist,domains 1 -1'), hence 'mul round=int' and NO per_domain -- nests derive their own dt from the parent (share/set_timekeeping.F:339-359 sets the head grid, :365-369 divides by parent_time_step_ratio). Nothing in share/module_check_a_mundo.F constrains time_step against time_step_sound (a grep for time_step_sound there returns zero hits; :887-894 is a presence check only), so a dt/dts pairing is never diagnosed -- it simply runs or goes unstable.

A02.description: time_step_sound=6 on every active domain (acoustic substeps), the ACCURACY mirror of D01's 3. The namelist default 0 means AUTO: dyn_em/solve_em.F:451-468 computes max(2*(INT(300*dt/min(dx,dy)-0.01)+1),4), and because the 2* multiplier sits inside the max() whose floor 4 is itself even, the auto formula RETURNS EVEN NUMBERS ONLY -- its own comment says so (solve_em.F:452: 'This function will give 4 for 6*dx and 6 for 10*dx and returns even numbers only'). All six original campaign cases land on 4. ONLY EVEN VALUES ARE SAFE: RK3 substep 2 sets number_of_small_timesteps = num_sound_steps/2 as INTEGER division (solve_em.F:615, against :611 for substep 1 and :619 for substep 3), so an odd value silently truncates substep 2's acoustic loop -- which is why D01's 3 hung conus12, and why 6 (not 5) is the accuracy step above the auto 4. 6 raises the small-step count 50% and cuts dts = dt/num_sound_steps (solve_em.F:470) by the same factor, lowering the acoustic CFL. WRF validates this knob nowhere: an explicit value is taken verbatim at solve_em.F:467, and share/module_check_a_mundo.F never mentions time_step_sound.

A03.description: moist_adv_opt=2 and scalar_adv_opt=2 on every active domain (MONOTONIC transport), the ACCURACY mirror of D03's 0. Registry.EM_COMMON:2927/2931 default both to 1, and the Registry package lines 3330-3334 fix the meanings exactly: 0=original, 1=positivedef, 2=monotonic, 3=weno_scalar, 4=wenopd_scalar -- so 1 (the default) is positive-definite and 2 is monotonic. The dispatch is in dyn_em/module_em.F:1265 (POSITIVEDEF -> advect_scalar_pd) versus :1282 (MONOTONIC -> advect_scalar_mono), both guarded by rk_step == rk_order, i.e. the limiter runs only on the LAST RK substep. Positive-definite only forbids negative mixing ratios; monotonic additionally forbids the transport step from creating new extrema, which is the stronger (and more expensive) statement. INCOMPATIBLE WITH A04 -- see the 'A03 + A04 combined' entry in 'excluded': advect_scalar_mono implements h_sca_adv_order 5 ONLY (dyn_em/module_advect_em.F:9643) and calls wrf_error_fatal on anything else at :10016-10017.

skip_cases.isc21: isc21's own namelist already sets moist_adv_opt=2,2,2 and scalar_adv_opt=2,2,2, so monotonic transport is a no-op there, not an accuracy change

A04.description: h_mom_adv_order=6 and h_sca_adv_order=6 on every active domain (Registry.EM_COMMON:2922/2924, both default 5; no campaign namelist sets either, so every case is at the default). VERIFIED AVAILABLE IN THIS BUILD, which is why this is a template and not an 'excluded' entry: order 6 is a real 6th-order flux stencil in every routine that reads these knobs -- advect_u dyn_em/module_advect_em.F:230, advect_v :1640, advect_scalar :3137, advect_w :4470, advect_scalar_pd :6229 -- and none of those branches sits behind a preprocessor guard (module_advect_em.F has 6 '#if' lines, none of them in the order-dispatch chains). EVEN ORDERS ARE LEGAL: each chain is an IF/ELSE IF named horizontal_order_test with real branches for 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2 (and 0 = horizontal advection off, :1231-1233); anything outside the chain falls through to wrf_error_fatal (:1237-1238 for advect_u, and the same pattern at :2687, :4099, :5684, :7250, :10016). Two hard limits found while verifying: (1) order > 6 is impossible regardless -- the communication halos only exist up to 6 and dyn_em/solve_em.F:414 aborts with 'invalid h_sca_adv_order'; (2) the MONOTONIC limiter supports order 5 ONLY (advect_scalar_mono, module_advect_em.F:9643, fatal at :10016-10017), so this template must never be combined with A03 and is skipped for isc21, whose namelist already runs moist_adv_opt=2,2,2. Note that nothing in share/module_check_a_mundo.F catches either -- a grep of that file for 'adv_order' and for 'adv_opt' returns ZERO hits, so an illegal combination is only discovered as a fatal mid-integration. KNOWN GAP in that guard: it is a per-case skip_cases entry, and predictor/physics.py's generic_extra_edits fallback (the path taken for a case physics_templates.json has never seen) cannot reproduce it, because native_physics_resolved carries only the LEDGER physics columns and moist_adv_opt is not one of them. Before running A04 on a NEW case, grep its namelist.input for moist_adv_opt / scalar_adv_opt = 2 by hand. Why this is an accuracy lever: the default 5th order is the odd-order upwind-biased member of the pair, whose leading error term is an implicit hyperdiffusion; 6th order is the centred, non-diffusive member, i.e. less damped and one order more accurate, but it supplies no dissipation of its own (diff_opt/km_opt are unchanged and remain the only explicit diffusion).

skip_cases.isc21: isc21 natively runs moist_adv_opt=2,2,2 / scalar_adv_opt=2,2,2 (monotonic), and advect_scalar_mono implements h_sca_adv_order 5 only (dyn_em/module_advect_em.F:9643) -- h_sca_adv_order=6 would abort at module_advect_em.F:10016-10017 mid-integration, with no namelist-time check to catch it

A05.description: radt x0.5 on every active domain (more frequent radiation calls), the ACCURACY mirror of P02's x2. radt is a REAL max_domains field (Registry.EM_COMMON:2473, default 0), so unlike A01's INTEGER time_step this edit needs no rounding and carries no min clamp: karina/conus12/bigchill/elevconv 15->7.5, conus25 10->5.0, maria1km 12,30->6.0,15.0, lafe 1->0.5, marshall 1->0.5. A clamp of min 1 would have made lafe and marshall no-ops, which is exactly the trap P02's 'min 1' does not hit because it multiplies upward. WRF converts radt to whole steps at phys/module_physics_init.F:2276-2277 (STEPRA = nint(radt*60/dt), then max(STEPRA,1)), so the lever saturates once radt*60/dt reaches ~1: lafe at dt=10 goes 6 steps -> 3, marshall at dt=6 goes 10 -> 5. The call gate is phys/module_radiation_driver.F:1125-1127 (MOD(itimestep,stepra) == 1+ra_call_offset), with radt=0 special-cased to every step at :1119-1120 and the first step always forced at :1113-1114 -- so a case whose native radt is 0 is already at the accuracy limit and this template is a harmless no-op there (0 x 0.5 = 0). Deliberately NOT paired with swint_opt=1: P01/P02 add the solar-zenith interpolation to compensate for sparse radiation calls, and halving the interval removes the deficiency it was compensating for.

excluded.A03 + A04 combined (monotonic transport: RUNTIME ABORT, not a namelist-time error. advect_scalar_mono implements h_sca_adv_order 5 ONLY -- dyn_em/module_advect_em.F:9643 is the single horizontal_order_test branch in that routine, and everything else falls through to wrf_error_fatal at :10016-10017. share/module_check_a_mundo.F never mentions adv_order or adv_opt at all (zero grep hits), so the combination passes every namelist check and dies mid-integration. A03 and A04 are therefore run as SEPARATE templates only, and both skip isc21 (native moist_adv_opt/scalar_adv_opt = 2,2,2)
excluded.h_mom_adv_order/h_sca_adv_order 7 or hig: impossible in any build: the communication halos are only generated up to order 6, and dyn_em/solve_em.F:414 aborts with 'solve_em: invalid h_sca_adv_order' (same guard at :397/:405 and in module_first_rk_step_part1.F:1391-1396). 6 is the hard ceiling A04 already sits at
excluded.time_step_sound = 5 (or any odd accuracy: odd acoustic substep counts are unsafe: RK3 substep 2 uses number_of_small_timesteps = num_sound_steps/2 as INTEGER division (dyn_em/solve_em.F:615), and WRF's own auto formula returns even numbers only (solve_em.F:451-468, comment at :452). D01's odd 3 hung conus12. A02 uses 6, the next EVEN value above the auto 4
excluded.ra_lw_physics/ra_sw_physics=24 or 14: RRTMG-fast and RRTMK are not compiled in this build (configure.wrf BUILD_RRTMG_FAST=0, BUILD_RRTMK=0); WRF aborts at share/module_check_a_mundo.F:2911-2941
excluded.h_mom_adv_order/h_sca_adv_order 5->3, di: probe REJECT on all six cases (job 1076060)
excluded.use_adaptive_time_step: probe REJECT on five of six cases; timing with a variable dt is not comparable per step
excluded.epssm: terrain-only indirect gain, no speed evidence
valid only for dx >= 10 km (conus12 here) -- cannot generalise across the six cases
excluded.e_vert: needs real.exe regeneration of wrfinput, not a namelist-only change
excluded.cu_physics/cudt: cumulus is on only for isc21 d01 among the six cases
excluded.km_opt 4->1 / diff_opt 1->0: same family as the probe-REJECTed h_mom_adv_order/diff_opt entry (job 1076060); revisit only if D01-D03 show the dynamics bucket is worth more measurement
